claimRules.retention: Requires a baseline plus unaided retrieval in a separate session after at least 24 hours.
claimRules.transfer: Requires a changed representation or materially changed problem form; repeated identical items do not establish transfer.
claimRules.mastery: Requires repeated unaided success, separate sessions, changed representations and delayed retrieval.
claimRules.engagement: Behavioral activity is reported as behavior only and cannot be relabeled as learning.
claimRules.experience: Ratings and comments describe experience only and cannot be relabeled as learning.

outcomes.label: Delayed unaided retrieval
outcomes.numerator: learners with a correct, unaided retrieval in a separate session at least 24 hours after prior evidence
outcomes.denominator: learners with at least two eligible retrieval opportunities
outcomes.limitations: Evidence is limited to reviewed in-app items and does not by itself establish broad transfer.

outcomes.label: Changed-representation success
outcomes.numerator: learners with unaided success in at least two reviewed representations
outcomes.denominator: learners exposed to at least two eligible representations
outcomes.limitations: A representation change is only a bounded transfer indicator.

outcomes.label: Product activity
outcomes.denominator: consenting visits represented in the analytics dataset
outcomes.limitations: Activity is not learning, retention or mastery and never changes the learning ledger.

outcomes.label: Voluntary app rating
outcomes.numerator: sum and distribution of submitted ratings
outcomes.limitations: Self-selected experience feedback is not a learning outcome.

outcomes.label: Mechanic exposure and action
outcomes.numerator: acted events for the named mechanic
outcomes.denominator: exposed events for the same mechanic
outcomes.limitations: Exposure is needed to interpret an intervention; acting is not evidence of learning.

outcomes.label: Communication suppression, opt-out and adverse signals
outcomes.numerator: suppressed, failed, bounced or opted-out communication events
outcomes.limitations: Low counts can be identifying and must not be segmented or exposed.
